description: A running pace calculator: give any two of distance, time and pace to get the third. A HelpySelf tool (helpyself.com).

distance.description: How far, in the unit named by `unit`. Give any two of distance, timeSeconds and paceSecondsPerUnit and the third is worked out.

paceSecondsPerUnit.description: Pace in seconds per `unit`, so 315 with unit km is 5:15 per kilometre. Ignored when distance and timeSeconds are both given, since those two determine it.

timeSeconds.description: Total time in seconds, so 3150 is 52 minutes 30 seconds.

unit.description: The unit `distance` and `paceSecondsPerUnit` are read in. The answer always reports pace per kilometre and per mile, whichever was given.

name: pace_calculator
title: Pace Calculator
